text:
Maya: heads-up: FP8 mixed-mode runs on the L40S show intermittent liveness failures when activation scaling spikes. repro @ 10k tokens in long-chat trace.
Alex H: hmm, seen anything similar on H100?
Maya: H100 is fine in these exact runs. L40S only; appears tied to activation_scale_factor > 1.75 on some layers.
Chen: can you paste the failing stack/logs?
Maya: sure — snippet:```
[2026-11-03T14:12:03Z] runtime: step=10234 model=redwood-3b fp8-mode=mixed activation_scale=1.82 kv_cache_miss=0.04 error=OOM_recoverable liveness=false
[2026-11-03T14:12:03Z] backtrace: runtime/kernel_fp8.c:842 adjust_scale()->clip->fallback_to_int8()
```
Rachel: OOM_recoverable + fallback_to_int8 indicates kernel quant path expecting a slightly different tiling/accum pattern on L40S. Does enabling per-layer clipping change repro?
Maya: quick test: per-layer clip to 6.0 reduced rate but didn't eliminate.
Sam: could be scheduling interacting with continuous batching. If batcher increases seq-len variance, activation scale estimator overshoots. Try lowering max_batch_window on L40S canary.
Alex H: agree. Also consider switching the quant_scheduler to heuristics that prefer kv-cache-preserving tiles. We rolled quant_sched_v1 early; v2 has smoother scaling.
Maya: how would we flip on canary?
dev-bot: deploy request queued: /canary-deploy quant_sched=quant_sched_v2 target=redwood-3b region=l40s-pool-7
Rachel: add metric hooks: track per_token_ppl and activation_scale_factor histogram. If ppl jumps correlated with scale spikes -> model-level sensitivity.
Maya: added dashboards, running a 12h canary now.
Sam: an extra safety: config snippet to avoid sudden activation jumps —```
quant_scheduler:
  mode: heuristic_v2
  max_scale_step: 0.05
  init_scale: 1.0
  bump_threshold: 0.9  # triggers slower scaling when tail-latency high
  prefer_tiles: [kv_preserve, low_accum]
```
Maya: test results after 3 hours: liveness failures down from ~6/hr to 0. Repro on long replay still occasionally fails at 1/1000.
Chen: ok that residual sounds like numerical edge-case. Let's add a tiny smoothing window on activation estimator and a fallback that doesn't trigger full int8 fallback — instead degrade to fp16 for that layer.
Alex H: agree. which code path to change? runtime/kernel_fp8.c adjust_scale() and runtime/dispatch.c fallback_policy.
Rachel: also run a quick AWQ/GPTQ compare for that layer to see if quant spec matters. AWQ might be more stable on accum patterns.
Maya: schedule: 1) land quant_sched_v2 canary on L40S (in progress) 2) add smoothing + fp16-soft-fallback MR (Chen) 3) run AWQ vs GPTQ per-layer bakeoff on the failing set (Rachel) 4) if stable, roll to dedicated pools.
Sam: ping me when CI for soft-fallback lands; I'll run long throughput stress with mixed seqs.
dev-bot: canary-deploy completed: id=cd-20261103-57 status=ok
Maya: nice. early telemetry looks green. thanks all. :thumbsup:
